stations.title: Saw: cut to finished size
stations.does: Saw the chipboard panel to the required finished dimensions.
steps: Position panel against the cutting fence/stop
Clamp panel to the cutting table/fence
Start dust extraction
Run saw across marked/controlled cut path to produce finished dimensions
Release clamp and carry panel to the outfeed position

stations.title: Edge band gluing & press
stations.does: Glue edge banding onto the visible edges of the cut panel.
steps: Bring panel to edge-banding location
Apply glue/adhesive along panel edges (controlled path around rectangle)
Place edge band onto the glued edges
Press/hold edge band using a pressure shoe/rollers until bond is formed (time budget within takt)
Trim/flush any edge band overhang to panel perimeter
Release panel to outfeed

stations.title: Drill hinge & dowel holes
stations.does: Drill hinge and dowel holes in the finished panel.
steps: Place panel in drilling nest/fixture reference points
Align to programmed hole pattern (via stops/locators)
Start dust extraction for drill zone
Drill hinge cup holes and dowel holes to programmed depth
Clear chips from holes (air blast/brush) without damaging edges
Release panel to outfeed

stations.title: Periodic dimension inspection
stations.does: Operator checks panel dimensions periodically and identifies any out-of-tolerance parts.
steps: Operator receives panel at inspection position
Check dimensions using hand gauge/measuring device according to sampling rule
Mark status: OK or out-of-tolerance
If out-of-tolerance: divert panel to rework/scrap outfeed bin (manual diversion signal/actuator)
If OK: allow panel to proceed to pallet staging

stations.title: Stack panels onto pallet
stations.does: Stack finished panels onto a pallet for downstream assembly.
steps: Pick/transfer approved panel from conveyor to pallet stack location
Orient panel consistently (use pallet corner stops/edge alignment)
Place panel onto existing stack; ensure stack sits square
Apply interleaving/spacing if used (optional, depends on downstream requirement)
Advance pallet stack position when current layer is complete
Return pallet-ready status and continue receiving next panel

notes: All stations are budgeted at the full takt (40 s) to guarantee the line can run at 90 finished panels/hour; this implies the builder should design tooling so each operation reliably completes within 40 s or add parallelism (not modeled).
Dust extraction is required at the saw and drill operations; the builder should allocate separate extraction ducts to ST1 and ST3 and include interlocks (not modeled).

Periodic sampling inspection is represented as operator checks; since the tolerance criteria and sampling frequency are not specified, the diversion logic is kept manual (out-of-tolerance panels are diverted to rework/scrap).

Edge band bonding/press/hold time is not specified; ST2 assumes sufficient bond/trim action within 40 s, but if curing requires longer time, ST2 will need an in-line dwell/transfer buffer (not modeled).
